cases.title: prayer stoning
cases.mission: Set timed stoning via wizard intrinsic then force successful prayer
cases.selectionRationale: Planned source/state/actions before any comparison of this case. Setup corrections use observed C inventory letters, prompt acknowledgments and source-proven choices. Distinct C outcomes survive regardless of JS result.
cases.sourceTrace: C wizcmds.c949-1006 builds a four-page PICK_ANY property menu. At segment0 step16 colon, wintty.c1705-1709 calls tty_getlin Search for. C leaves the menu rows intact beneath the prompt. JS getline.js157 flush_screen and display.js6131 _buildScreenOutput repaint the map over those rows. Diagnostic records full C and JS screens, with unchanged RNG. C hooked_tty_getlin uses WIN_MESSAGE and inread gating instead of treating an active menu as the map.

cases.mission: Set timed stoning via wizard intrinsic then force successful prayer
cases.selectionRationale: Planned source/state/actions before any comparison of this case. Setup corrections use observed C inventory letters, prompt acknowledgments and source-proven choices. Distinct C outcomes survive regardless of JS result.
cases.sourceTrace: C wizcmds.c949-1006 builds a four-page PICK_ANY property menu. At segment0 step16 colon, wintty.c1705-1709 calls tty_getlin Search for. C leaves the menu rows intact beneath the prompt. JS getline.js157 flush_screen and display.js6131 _buildScreenOutput repaint the map over those rows. Diagnostic records full C and JS screens, with unchanged RNG. C hooked_tty_getlin uses WIN_MESSAGE and inread gating instead of treating an active menu as the map.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Forget a remembered engraving when force-fighting empty terrain
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: At segment0 step14 key l, hack.c:domove_fight_empty calls unmap_object after the thin-air attack. C display.c408-438 handles an engraving glyph; JS explicitly refuses forgetting a square that shows an engraving, before matching the frame.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Whole display.c:unmap_object and its empty-forcefight callers; reconcile engraving memory glyph ownership.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Drop a nonboulder object at an existing trap
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: The off-stair move falls into a pit. A neutral altar is wished onto that same square and a cursed dagger is dropped. At segment0 step35 C dropx786/dropz807 calls flooreffects162; ordinary nonboulder pit drop survives and altar landing gives a black flash. JS do.js1927 refuses shipping or floor effects at a trap. Count the trap/liquid floor-effects admission family once.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Whole do.c:dropx/dropy/dropz/flooreffects source closure or source-traced bounded nonboulder trap-drop admission; include production drop environment.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Successful prayer consumes a strangulation amulet
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: C pray.c388-396 prints amulet vanishes, calls useup(uamul), then clears Strangled. JS pray.js1273 records invent.c useup without removing the object. RNG matches throughout; inventory at segment0 step62 retains an Amulets header in JS where C begins Weapons. Source order and consumed object identity establish the first divergence.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Bounded fix_worst_trouble TROUBLE_STRANGLED canonical useup caller reconciliation; no need to invent amulet removal state.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Search an active multiselection intrinsic menu without replacing its rows with map glyphs
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: C wizcmds.c949-1006 builds a four-page PICK_ANY property menu. At segment0 step16 colon, wintty.c1705-1709 calls tty_getlin Search for. C leaves the menu rows intact beneath the prompt. JS getline.js157 flush_screen and display.js6131 _buildScreenOutput repaint the map over those rows. Diagnostic records full C and JS screens, with unchanged RNG. C hooked_tty_getlin uses WIN_MESSAGE and inread gating instead of treating an active menu as the map.
qualifyingSessions.wholeSourceScope: Source-traced active-menu getlin/flush-screen contract repair across whole existing TTY helper owners; preserve menu rows and independent WIN_MESSAGE coordinates/state.

qualifyingSessions.sourceBehavior: Successful prayer purifies lycanthropy and stops the later were-change draw
qualifyingSessions.sourceTrace: C pray.c514 calls you_unwere(TRUE); were.c213-231 prints purified and set_ulycn(NON_PM). JS pray.js1385 notes were.c you_unwere and leaves ulycn. At segment0 step51 the next turn C reaches allmain.c360 rn2(40+3*DEX)=rn2(88), while JS takes the now-unwanted allmain.js1041 rn2(80) were-change draw. C step52 also prints purified while JS does not.
